questions.text: Will the #1 song on the Billboard Hot 100 next week be the same title that is #1 this week, per Billboard's chart?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per Billboard's Hot 100 chart, next week's #1 title matches this week's #1 title. Billboard's chart update depends on a future tracking week and is never determinable before this round's own lock.

questions.text: Will the S&P 500 close higher one week from today than it closed most recently as of today, per WSJ market data?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per the S&P 500 (SPX) official closing value on the WSJ Markets quote page, the close on the trading session nearest one week after today's date is higher than today's most recent close. "One week from today" names a fixed point exactly 7 days out regardless of which weekday the round happens to publish on, so it is always a future close, never determinable before this round's own lock.

questions.text: Will the lead headline on the NYTimes.com homepage one week from now be a different story than today's lead headline, per nytimes.com?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per a same-time comparison of the lead headline on nytimes.com, the headline one week from now differs from today's. A future comparison, never determinable before this round's own lock.

questions.text: Will at least one game across the NFL, NBA, NHL, or MLB (whichever leagues are in season) in the 7 days from today go to overtime or extra innings, per official league box scores?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per the official box scores on NFL.com, NBA.com, NHL.com, or MLB.com, at least one regular-season or playoff game among those four leagues played in the 7 days from today's date goes to overtime (NFL/NBA/NHL) or extra innings (MLB). At least one of the four leagues is in season every week of the calendar year, so this is never trivially decided by an off-season, and it depends on games not yet played — never determinable before this round's own lock.

questions.text: Will the #1 movie at the U.S. box office one week from today be a title not in this week's top 5, per Box Office Mojo's weekend chart?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per Box Office Mojo's weekend domestic chart, the #1 title on the weekend chart nearest one week from today is not among this week's top 5. "One week from today" is a fixed 7-day-out point regardless of which weekday the round publishes on, so it always names a future weekend's results, never determinable before this round's own lock.
